positions.name: AsyncRememberDispatchContract
positions.frame: how does the async remember contract handle job dispatch, execution tracking, and reaction delivery?
positions.why: Both expressions define the mechanics of the non-blocking remember contract: src-1 establishes the ratified receipt return and cursor polling to ensure resilience against dropped receipts, while src-2 frames the operational choices between polling the run directly versus receiving piggybacked reactions on subsequent calls.
